Use interpretation_catalog meanings; they are possibilities, never proof of an application. The unknown array must start with {"type":"unknown","topic":"intent"} and {"type":"unknown","topic":"complete_visibility"}, in that order. Optionally append process_identity and/or payload. Keep the report concise.
